# What's new in Power Automate

Resources to learn about features released recently, features releasing soon, and known issues.

## Weekly releases
See Service Updates for Power Automate. Releases roll out over several days; new or updated functionality might not appear immediately.

## Release plans
Get familiar with upcoming features in the Power Automate release planner.
